settings.title: Accessibility
settings.lede: We want every fan to be able to shop this store, read about the team and follow the season.
settings.body:
1. Our goal

We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, level AA. That includes keyboard navigation, visible focus, text alternatives for images, enough color contrast, and respecting reduced-motion settings.

2. What we are doing

  • Reviewing pages when we add new products or sections.
  • Writing alt text for team and tractor photos.
  • Letting you pause any moving content.

3. Known limits

Some content comes from third parties, such as embedded videos, checkout and payment screens, which we do not fully control.

4. Need help?

If something on the store is hard to use, send us a message on the contact form or use the details in Contact Information. Tell us the page and the problem and we will help you place your order another way. We reply within 2 business days.

settings.title: Cookie Preferences
settings.lede: Cookies are small files your browser saves when you visit. Some keep the store working. The rest are optional, and you decide.
settings.body:
1. The cookie banner

On your first visit, a banner from Shopify, the platform that runs our store, asks what you allow. Choose Accept, Decline or Manage preferences to pick each type. Until you choose, only necessary cookies are used.

2. Types of cookies

  • Necessary: always on. Cart, checkout, login and security.
  • Analytics: shows us which pages and products fans use.
  • Marketing: lets ad partners like Facebook and Google measure ads.
  • Preferences: remembers choices like your region.

3. Where your choice is saved

Your choice is saved in this browser on this device, whether or not you have an account. If you use another browser or device, or clear your cookies, the banner asks again.

4. Change your choice

Use the button above, or click Cookie Preferences at the bottom of any page to open the banner again. Changes apply right away.

5. Global Privacy Control (GPC)

If your browser sends a Global Privacy Control signal, we treat it as a request to opt out of sale and sharing: marketing cookies stay off and we do not ask again. See Your Privacy Choices and the Privacy Policy.
